Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: This step marks the entry into the loop (Rule 1) where the WebServing_Expert repeatedly requests user verification without providing a clear plan to exit the loop. The step does not fabricate or misuse data (Rule 2), but it initiates a repetitive cycle that becomes difficult to recover from (Rule 3), as no further progress is made in verifying the quoted text. This makes it the first point of irrecoverable error.
